# Synthetic DOCX fixtures

`generate.py` uses only Python's standard library and produces deterministic
`coverage.docx` and `comments.docx` archives. Neither contains private documents.
`legal-opinion.docx` is a scrubbed real document; see
[below](#scrubbed-legal-opinion).
The comments fixture is required at compile time by the comment-extraction tests
and at runtime by preview lifecycle/worker tests.

Both synthetic archives are included in the changes. To regenerate them before
running Cargo:

```sh
python3 tests/fixtures/docx-preview/generate.py
```

Run from the repository root. The generator rewrites both archives
deterministically (identical to the included bytes).

Verified SHA-256 digests:

- `comments.docx`: `6e5eac8104d6310c0da4d21c92ed18e35c52001cc01351e892b097537428b5e1`
- `coverage.docx`: `baa3f1b2c5cef58afc57d6680fb172d4720c57c8f3d1e1c0f6be1ad344e707d1`

## Scrubbed legal opinion

`legal-opinion.docx` is the ordinary legal-document workload for `just perf`
(`legal_opinion` in the host matrix, and `large_markdown_scroll_budget`). It
comes from a real 37-page English legal opinion (16,700 words, 223 paragraphs,
139 numbered/bulleted items, four tables, eight footnotes, header logo, footer
table and page fields) that is not distributed. `scrub.py` produced it:
structure, styles, numbering, sections and run formatting are unchanged, and
each run keeps its character count. Every word of three or more letters
except function words is replaced by a dictionary word of the same length chosen
by position, not derived from the original, so the text cannot be
reconstructed; digits likewise. Images are blank PNGs of the same size; author,
Grammarly and alt-text metadata and external link targets are neutralized. Its
imported Markdown has the same line count and Markdown structure as the
original's (115,662 versus 115,967 bytes). Reading the text is meaningless; it
is a layout workload, not a conversion or PII fixture.

```sh
python3 -I tests/fixtures/docx-preview/scrub.py <private.docx>
```

- `legal-opinion.docx`: `59e595ba9d336e8f985e3f2eec23f709a53012fe215ebdc9861823ae010aaef4`

Other local DOCX files in this directory are not generated by these scripts and
are not required by the default workspace gate. Do not distribute or overwrite
them as part of fixture generation.
